summary.title: Summary

AirportInfo.title: AirportInfo
AirportInfo.description: From the organisers' airports.csv. For labels and maps; the rules never read it.

label.title: Label
label.description: Short human title, e.g. 'EASA Air OPS CAT.OP.MPA.181(c)(5) Final reserve fuel'

text.title: Text
text.description: What the source says: rule text, passage quote, metric definition

passage_id.title: Passage Id
passage_id.description: Regulation/brief passage behind a rule or metric

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: A source resolved from the semantic model, ready to render as a footnote.

CodeSet.title: CodeSet
CodeSet.description: What each raw coded value means. Agents read labels/definitions, never guess.

Concept.title: Concept
Concept.description: A box in the reference ontology. Entity types declare which concept they are.

EntityType.title: EntityType
EntityType.description: A concept as it exists in *this* dataset / scenario, bound to columns or marked synthetic.

id.title: Id
id.description: Citation number. The agent's text refers to it as [id]

claim.title: Claim
claim.description: Short factual statement, e.g. 'ORD Jan 17-19h weather delay p90 is 0 min'

source.title: Source
source.description: What backs the claim, as a semantic-model reference: 'metric:<name>' (queried this action), 'rule:<id>', 'passage:<id>', 'code:<CodeSet>.<value>', 'scenario:<field>', or 'check_proposal'

grounded.title: Grounded
grounded.description: False when the source does not resolve in the semantic model, or a metric is cited without having been queried. The UI should flag these

citation.description: What the source says, resolved from the model

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: high: regulation/standard, rule engine, code set, or a metric over >= 100 flights. medium: brief-derived rule, scenario fact, or a smaller sample. low: synthetic scenario field or ungrounded

Evidence-Input.title: Evidence
Evidence-Input.description: One claim an agent relies on, tied to the semantic-model element it comes from.

evaluation.description: null when no option in the window passes every hard rule

report.description: passed=false: the reply was sent back to the agent with these violations (or, after the last repair, blocked)

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Submits it took; >1 means the agent was sent back

GuardrailReport.title: GuardrailReport
GuardrailReport.description: Result of the citation guardrails on one agent reply.

sql_tool_available.title: Sql Tool Available
sql_tool_available.description: all three CSVs present: agents can call query_metric

KnowledgePassage.title: KnowledgePassage
KnowledgePassage.description: A quotable chunk of the brief or a regulation. Briefings cite these by id.

mock.title: Mock
mock.description: Scripted agents, no LLM calls. For UI development.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort per agent call. Higher is slower. Default: server setting

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: consensus: agents agreed on a feasible plan. fallback: no consensus, the deterministic solver picked the cheapest feasible plan. no_legal_option: nothing in the window passes every hard rule; `final` is the last attempt, NOT a recommendation, and a human must decide.

arrival_min.title: Arrival Min
arrival_min.description: Revised arrival, minutes after scheduled arrival

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: One or two sentences, plain language, with [n] citation markers

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Claims the plan relies on, each with its model source. Empty for the deterministic solver

guardrail.description: Citation guardrail result; null for the solver
